title: SpaceX IPO Set to Be a Catalyst for 2026 IPO Boom: ETFs to Gain
title_zh: SpaceX IPO 将成为 2026 年 IPO 热潮的催化剂：ETF 将获利
summary: SpaceX could be the catalyst for a surge as the U.S. IPO market eyes a comeback. ETFs like FPX, IPO and IPOS offer an easy way to gain exposure.
summary_zh: 随着美国 IPO 市场有望卷土重来，SpaceX 可能成为股价飙升的催化剂。 FPX、IPO 和 IPOS 等 ETF 提供了一种获得投资的简单方法。

title: SpaceX Eyes IPO as Market Conditions Grow More Uncertain. What the Charts Show.
title_zh: 随着市场状况变得更加不确定，SpaceX 考虑进行 IPO。图表显示什么。
summary: The prospect of a SpaceX IPO has become a key focal point for markets, and any delay tied to deteriorating conditions could carry broader implications.
summary_zh: SpaceX 首次公开募股的前景已成为市场的主要焦点，任何因情况恶化而导致的延误都可能带来更广泛的影响。

title: ETFs in Focus as Anthropic Eyes IPO: A Blockbuster on the Way?
title_zh: ETF 成为 Anthropic Eyes IPO 焦点：重磅炸弹即将到来？
summary: Anthropic's potential IPO could be a $60B blockbuster. Here's how AI and IPO-focused ETFs may benefit from one of the biggest listings in the tech space.
summary_zh: Anthropic 潜在的 IPO 可能会成为 60B 美元的重磅炸弹。以下是专注于人工智能和 IPO 的 ETF 如何从科技领域最大的上市之一中受益。

title: Chart of the Day 2-16-26- With Past IPOs Slumping, Will Mega-Deals Proceed
title_zh: 每日图表 2-16-26-过去的 IPO 数量大幅下滑，大型交易是否会继续进行
summary: This COULD be the year of the mega-IPO – with top Artificial Intelligence (AI) companies and SpaceX eyeing 2026 public market debuts. But the performance of past Initial Public Offerings is souring, raising questions about investor enthusiasm for big deals.
summary_zh: 今年可能是大型 IPO 之年——顶级人工智能 (AI) 公司和 SpaceX 都计划在 2026 年公开市场首次亮相。但过去首次公开募股的表现正在恶化，引发了人们对投资者对大型交易热情的质疑。

title: U.S. IPO Proceeds Set to Quadruple in 2026? ETFs to Consider
title_zh: 2026 年美国 IPO 收益将翻两番？值得考虑的ETF
summary: As dealmaking momentum builds, the U.S. IPO market may be gearing up for a comeback in 2026. ETFs like FPX, IPO, FPXI and IPOS provide a low-stress way to play the trend.
summary_zh: 随着交易势头增强，美国 IPO 市场可能会在 2026 年卷土重来。FPX、IPO、FPXI 和 IPOS 等 ETF 提供了一种轻松应对这一趋势的方式。
